description: This file defines a PHP trait `LDAPConnectionHelperTrait` within the `OrangeHRM` project, specifically for LDAP connection configurations in the testing namespace. It provides utility methods for checking LDAP server configuration and retrieving configuration details from a YAML file.

methods.name: isLDAPServerConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the LDAP server configuration file exists and is accessible.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP server configuration as an `LDAPServerConfig` object, parsing data from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfigFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the LDAP server configuration YAML file.
